page_title: NAP 2-2 FRO | Napoli v Frosinone 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' The match has ended for Mario Rui (Napoli) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Michael Fabbri pulls out a red card!
90+7' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+5' Here is a change. Nadir Zortea is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Mateus Lusuardi (Frosinone).
90+5' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luca Mazzitelli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone).
90+4' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+2' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 18:13.
85' Substitution. Frank Anguissa leaves the pitch and is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
84' The game is interrupted now, Alex Meret (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
83' Demba Seck (Frosinone) wastes a huge opportunity. He attempts to knock a rebound low into the middle of the goal with a delicate header, but Alex Meret stretches to keep the ball out of the net.
80' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Fabbri blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Demba Seck (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Matias Soule.
78' A substitution has been made. Marco Brescianini goes off and Reinier (Frosinone) comes on.
78' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Piotr Zielinski and he is replaced by Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
77' The game has come to an end for Matteo Politano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
76' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati makes a comfortable save.

75' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Stefano Turati makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
73' 2 - 2 Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
72' A cooling break is underway.
70' The foul by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
70' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
68' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Mario Rui (Napoli) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
66' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:1.
63' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
58' The resulting free kick from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

56' The ball falls kindly for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
54' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Meret makes a huge mistake and Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
47' Napoli take a short corner kick.

47' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+3' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) and Matias Soule attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+1' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

43' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Stefano Turati shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
39' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
36' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Alex Meret.
35' Matias Soule (Frosinone) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!

30' Matias Soule (Frosinone) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Alex Meret to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
30' Matias Soule (Frosinone) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Yellow card. Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
28' Referee Michael Fabbri sees the trip by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Frosinone.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Stefano Turati.
24' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
22' A rebound bounces out to Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
20' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.

19' Matias Soule (Frosinone) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
19' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
16' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Matteo Politano (Napoli) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.

16' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
15' The corner from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.

14' What a wasted opportunity by Victor Osimhen (Napoli)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Stefano Turati makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
14' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
13' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.

10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
8' Matias Soule (Frosinone) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
8' An attempted cross from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) is cleared.
7' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone). Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
4' Stefano Turati (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) threads a pass through to Victor Osimhen, but Stefano Turati breaks up the move.
2' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will referee today's match.
